findings.issue: Carry-forward QA-004 is only partly closed. The SessionEvent to LogEvent adapter still exists twice: to_obs_event in sc-jev-py/src/logging.rs:263 and obs_event in sc-ai/src/observe.rs:142. The behavioural divergence is gone. Both now use the same fields, the same 'session' fallback action, and the same level, target and version. The duplication that could drift again remains.
findings.recommendation: Move the adapter next to LogEvent in sc-agent-types::observability::v2, or into a shared helper, and call it from both sites. Alternatively, record the duplication as an accepted risk and add a cross-crate equivalence test.
findings.evidence: The two function bodies are structurally identical. They differ only in field insertion order (BTreeMap-backed Map, so no wire effect) and in how the schema version and target are constructed.
